decisions.selection: Woven FIXED/RELATIVE anchors and erase-clipping versus replacement-whole-failure
decisions.reasonAndTradeoff: Fixed means cannot chase an aging memory after seeing a result. Erase preserves any still-valid literal portion; a replacement story is not automatically retimed. This asymmetry is explicit local design, not generic cast failure.

Restoration is useful but bounded by genuine original event/facet coverage, highest relevant originalDC and failed-attempt novelty. A merely contradictory statement cannot restore a private minute. This changes only the two named spells.

Retain area breadth including hidden/allied/caster bodies rather than require individual perception. One source-local body-center convention and ordinary line of effect avoid a moving or player-revealed roster.

decisions.selection: Permanent actual bounded ordinary plant output
decisions.reasonAndTradeoff: All100lb/5ftcube/10gp ceilings and examined actual composition remain simultaneous. Finished genuine mundane profiles use actual tool/pattern entitlement; no arbitrary one-object stock cap, recipe grant or guaranteed market cash.

Conserve M,C and exact mass; prevent C>M; ties use predeclared stable IDs. Actual order can change final allocation, openly accepted. Detached pieces are never globally rebalanced; merging cannot be a repair.

decisions.selection: AC10 only unknown loose soft stock, actual known cloth/paper/ropeAC11 first
decisions.reasonAndTradeoff: Source-specific existing item stats precede mass fallback. Zero does not delete physical mass or by itself decide food/ingredient chemistry; it supplies no functioning equipment.

decisions.selection: Completed memory and matter are outcomes, not ongoing spell fields
decisions.reasonAndTradeoff: Actual counters and local manifestation suppression still work. Later ordinary dispel does not reverse spent food, completed stock or instantaneous episodes; separately magical additions retain their own sources.
